title: Quiz Night on Wednesday 16 September
preheader: £3 cash entry, teams of up to six and a 7pm start. Reserve online, pay on the night.

data.heading: Who’s on your quiz team?
body: Bring your smartest mate and your best guesser to our Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night. Expect general knowledge, music, TV and film, free-drink questions and spot prizes.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Entry costs £3 per person, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Seating
rows.value: Communal tables, book your team together

data.heading: A few things to know
body: First prize is a £25 bar voucher, valid on food or drink for one month. Second-to-last place wins a bottle of wine.
First-time teams are welcome. Come early for dinner, served from 4pm to 9pm, and order before the first question.

data.body: Book everyone in your team together, then start thinking of a team name.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
